limits: All outcomes are synthetic stipulated observations; no proposed probe or actual-world outcome was measured. Support grades concern causal proposals, not whether cited observations were supplied.
Archive is frozen and incomplete: new means local novelty only. F03 equivalence remains uncertain; merely joining familiar aids does not demonstrate a new interaction.

Fit grades assess bounded next actions. Preserves is not empirical success; uncertainty about later adoption alone does not invalidate an existing-material diagnostic. No hard commitment is explicitly relaxed or definitely contradicted.
